findings.title: §7 misstates where PERMISSIONS is imported from
findings.problem: §7 says PERMISSIONS is imported 'from wherever requirePermission/PERMISSIONS are exported in server/utils/auth', but server/utils/auth.ts does not export PERMISSIONS. Verified in server/api/acl/show.post.ts and execute.post.ts: PERMISSIONS comes from the alias #shared/constants/rbac while requirePermission/assertSameOrigin come from ../../utils/auth.
findings.fix: State the imports explicitly for the test handlers: `import { PERMISSIONS } from '#shared/constants/rbac'` plus `import { assertSameOrigin, requirePermission } from '../../utils/auth'` and the matching envelope/network imports.

findings.title: ItopTicketModal v-model vs underlying UModal open-model left implicit
findings.problem: ItopTicketModal exposes modelValue/update:modelValue and is wired as <ItopTicketModal v-model=...>, but the repo's only UModal usage (DeviceCredentialsModal.vue) drives Nuxt UI's modal with v-model:open, not a bare v-model. The design does not say how modelValue is forwarded to the inner UModal (the exact wiring that is error-prone).
findings.fix: Add a line to §10.2: inside ItopTicketModal bind the inner modal with `<UModal :open="modelValue" @update:open="emit('update:modelValue', $event)">`, matching DeviceCredentialsModal.vue, because UModal uses the `open` model, not `modelValue`.

findings.title: pingItop runs SELECT 1 through array-expansion run() without noting intent
findings.problem: pingItop calls run('SELECT 1', []); harmless with mysql2 .query(), but the design does not warn against an implementer switching pingItop to conn.ping()/.execute(), which would bypass the Promise.race timeout bound and reintroduce the array-expansion concerns §5/round-two were built to avoid.
findings.fix: Note in §5 that SELECT 1 has no placeholder, pass [] and keep it going through run() so it inherits the Promise.race timeout; do not substitute conn.ping() or .execute().
